abstract: We study how individuals' migration decisions during a pandemic interact with the spatial allocation of hospital resources, characterizing both the laissez-faire equilibrium and the planner's allocation in closed form. Susceptible individuals leave high-infection cities while infected individuals move toward better-resourced ones, but these private decisions diverge from the planner's along two dimensions. First, the migration of infected agents toward susceptible-rich destinations raises transmission risk, a contagion externality the planner internalizes by restricting such flows. Second, the migration of infected agents toward better-resourced cities relieves hospital congestion at the epicenter, a congestion externality the planner internalizes by encouraging such flows. The two externalities work in opposite directions, and our comparative statics show when each dominates. The framework explains a cross-country pattern that standard misallocation theory cannot: during COVID-19, countries with greater regional dispersion in mortality tended to have lower aggregate mortality. This pattern arises naturally once contagion and endogenous mobility are added to a standard misallocation framework. More broadly, the analysis identifies a setting in which spatial dispersion can raise rather than reduce welfare, reversing the sign of the standard misallocation prescription.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了疫情期间个体迁移决策如何与医院资源的空间配置相互作用，并以闭式解形式刻画了自由放任均衡与规划者配置。易感个体离开高感染城市，而感染者则向资源更优的城市移动，但这些私人决策在两个方面与规划者的选择产生分歧。首先，感染者向易感人群密集目的地的迁移增加了传播风险，这是一种传染外部性，规划者通过限制此类流动将其内部化。其次，感染者向资源更优城市的迁移缓解了疫情中心的医院拥挤状况，这是一种拥挤外部性，规划者通过鼓励此类流动将其内部化。这两种外部性作用方向相反，我们的比较静态分析揭示了各自占优的条件。该框架解释了一种标准错配理论无法解释的跨国模式：在COVID-19期间，区域死亡率离散度较大的国家往往具有较低的总体死亡率。一旦将传染性和内生流动性纳入标准错配框架，这一模式便自然显现。更广泛而言，分析识别了一种情境，其中空间分散能够提高而非降低福利，从而逆转了标准错配处方的符号。
title: Contagion, migration, and misallocation in a pandemic
title_zh: 疫情中的传染、迁移与资源错配

abstract: Since 2015, global progress in improving energy efficiency has lagged behind the targets set by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, in part due to behavioral barriers to such improvement. Rising renewable energy adoption may impact energy efficiency improvement by raising or lowering these barriers. The well-documented rebound effect—where renewable energy adoption may increase energy consumption—could hinder efficiency gains, whereas renewable energy adoption may also raise awareness of energy use, thereby driving efficiency improvement. This paper examines whether and how renewable energy adoption influences energy efficiency improvement. Using data from 183 sites of a multinational industrial conglomerate from 2015 to 2020, we estimate the impact of changes in renewable energy usage and procurement methods on energy efficiency improvement. We find that using renewable energy to satisfy an additional 10% of a site’s energy demand caused an additional 2.8%–6.1% improvement in energy efficiency. However, the impact varies significantly depending on the procurement approach. Sourcing off-site renewable energy led to energy efficiency improvement, whereas installing on-site renewable energy generation had either no effect or a negative effect. To understand the mechanism, we surveyed site managers and conducted further analysis by leveraging variations in on-site generation costs. Our results indicate that the rebound effect prevailed when sites adopted renewable energy with low ongoing costs. For corporations expanding renewable energy usage, we offer evidence of additional energy efficiency benefits, but capitalizing on these benefits requires careful consideration of the procurement approach. For policymakers, we provide guidance on prioritizing certain procurement methods to accelerate progress toward net-zero. This paper was accepted by Jay Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165 .
abstract_zh: 自2015年以来，全球在提高能源效率方面的进展一直落后于联合国可持续发展目标设定的目标，部分原因在于此类改进面临的行为障碍。可再生能源应用的增加可能通过提高或降低这些障碍来影响能源效率的改进。有充分文献记载的回弹效应——即可再生能源应用可能增加能源消耗——可能阻碍效率提升，而可再生能源应用也可能提高对能源使用的认识，从而推动效率改进。本文考察了可再生能源应用是否以及如何影响能源效率改进。利用2015年至2020年间一家跨国工业集团183个场址的数据，我们估计了可再生能源使用量及采购方式的变化对能源效率改进的影响。研究发现，使用可再生能源满足场址额外10%的能源需求，带来了2.8%至6.1%的额外能源效率改进。然而，这种影响因采购方式的不同而存在显著差异。采购场外可再生能源促进了能源效率改进，而安装场内可再生能源发电设施则要么没有效果，要么产生负面影响。为理解其机制，我们对场址管理者进行了调查，并利用场内发电成本的差异进行了进一步分析。结果表明，当场址采用运营成本较低的可再生能源时，回弹效应占据主导。对于扩大可再生能源使用的企业，我们提供了额外能源效率效益的证据，但利用这些效益需要仔细考虑采购方式。对于政策制定者，我们提供了关于优先考虑某些采购方式以加速实现净零目标的指导。本文已被运营管理领域的Jay Swaminathan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165获取。

publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Does Renewable Energy Renew Energy Efficiency?
title_zh: 可再生能源能否提升能源效率？

abstract: Bhojraj et al. (2026) provide novel evidence that systemically large banks' internal loan loss forecasts systematically overreact to new information and that this overreaction is economically meaningful for loan loss provisioning. Our discussion focuses on whether the evidence identifies representativeness bias, as opposed to a broader set of behavioral, institutional, and economic mechanisms. We argue that the paper more convincingly documents overreaction than it isolates representativeness as the underlying mechanism. We revisit the role of bank information environment, data generating process, COVID-era uncertainty, endogenous bank responses, regulatory influences, and the interpretation of the CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) results relative to subsidiaries of IFRS 9 adopters. While several additional analyses are supportive of biased expectations, others suggest a more cautious reading of the mechanism. Our overall takeaway is that the paper's central contribution would be strengthened by framing the evidence more directly around overreaction in bank expectations formation and its implications for provisioning, while leaving greater room for multiple coexisting mechanisms and future research on how behavioral forces enter bank forecasting environments.
abstract_zh: Bhojraj等人（2026年）提供了新颖的证据，表明系统重要性银行的内部贷款损失预测系统性地对新增信息过度反应，且这种过度反应对贷款损失拨备具有经济意义上的重要性。我们的讨论聚焦于该证据是否识别出代表性偏差，而非更广泛的行为、制度及经济机制。我们认为，该论文更有说服力地记录了过度反应现象，而非将代表性偏差孤立为潜在机制。我们重新审视了银行信息环境、数据生成过程、新冠疫情时期的不确定性、银行内生反应、监管影响，以及CECL（当前预期信用损失）结果相对于采用IFRS 9的子公司之解释。尽管若干附加分析支持偏差预期的存在，但其他分析则提示应对机制解读持更为审慎的态度。总体而言，我们认为，若将证据更直接地围绕银行预期形成中的过度反应及其对拨备的影响进行框架构建，同时为多种共存机制及未来关于行为因素如何进入银行预测环境的研究留出更大空间，则该论文的核心贡献将得到加强。
title: What drives banks’ overreaction to loan loss information? Discussion of imperfect expectations in loan loss forecasts
title_zh: 什么驱动银行对贷款损失信息的过度反应？——贷款损失预测中非完美预期的探讨

abstract: We study development traps generated by payoff-mediated coordination between an institutional layer and a private-sector layer. The leading interpretation is the transition from informality to formal-sector participation: institutional effort raises the return to formalisation, while formal participation raises the fiscal, compliance, and legitimacy returns to institutional effort. The paper develops this mechanism through nested continuous-time replicator models. The one-population benchmark gives the familiar critical-mass and hysteresis result. The two-role follower model shows how a scalar threshold becomes a stable saddle branch. The main contribution is a leader–follower phase-plane analysis: we derive local stability conditions for joint poverty, joint prosperity, and decoupled regimes; give sufficient global conditions under which the stable manifold of an interior saddle is the basin boundary; and prove a comparison result showing that payoff-improving reforms weakly expand the basin of joint prosperity. A multi-role extension records local rare-deviation stability and monotone nullcline shifts, without claiming a complete global classification in four dimensions. The analysis implies that unilateral policy interventions do not fail by definition; they fail when the induced state remains in the basin of the low-activity equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 我们研究由制度层与私营部门层之间通过收益中介的协调所产生的“发展陷阱”。主导性解释是从非正规经济向正规部门参与的转型：制度努力提高了正规化的回报，而正规参与则提升了制度努力在财政、合规及合法性方面的回报。本文通过嵌套的连续时间复制者模型来阐述这一机制。单群体基准模型给出了熟悉的临界规模与滞后效应结果。双角色追随者模型展示了标量阈值如何演变为稳定的鞍分支。主要贡献在于领导者-追随者相平面分析：我们推导了共同贫困、共同繁荣及分离状态下的局部稳定性条件；给出了内部鞍点的稳定流形作为盆地边界的充分全局条件；并证明了一个比较结果，即收益改善型改革会弱扩展共同繁荣的盆地。多角色扩展记录了局部稀有偏差稳定性及单调零斜线移动，但未声称在四维空间中提供完整的全局分类。分析表明，单边政策干预并非必然失败；它们仅在所诱导的状态仍停留在低活动均衡的盆地内时才会失败。
title: On the dynamics of coordinated hierarchies: Economic growth versus poverty traps
title_zh: 协调层级动态研究：经济增长与贫困陷阱

title: Stimulating Climate Action through the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
title_zh: 通过欧盟碳边境调节机制激励气候行动

abstract: Land-use policy increasingly operates under conditions of shock and uncertainty, yet the mechanisms through which emergency measures produce persistent land take remain underexplored. In this paper, land take refers to land development involving the conversion of natural, semi-natural or agricultural land to artificial uses, often associated with impervious soil cover. The paper examines how post-earthquake road-access restrictions, safety cordons, and infrastructure-and-amenity siting choices interacted with road-network centrality and land-use change in L’Aquila, Italy. Using a configurational approach, namely Space Syntax, on reconstructed pre-earthquake and post-earthquake road networks, we compute segment-based Integration (NAIN) and Choice (NACH) at multiple radii and relate centrality deciles to a 2014 post-event census of commercial and public amenities through nearest-segment association and buffer-based sensitivity tests. Results show a strong spatial alignment between road closures in and around the historic centre, the emergence of high-centrality road corridors, notably Viale della Croce Rossa and the SS17, and the concentration of post-disaster amenities along those corridors and their immediate surroundings. Two peripheral district centres, Torrione and Torretta, also consolidated as locally autonomous service nuclei, reinforcing a more polycentric pattern that only partly aligned with statutory planning objectives. Rather than proposing a formal predictive model, the paper uses single-case evidence to show how road-network diagnostics can help identify corridors where temporary land uses and emergency-related land take are most likely to persist; support decisions on the reopening of strategic road links; and inform time-bound rules for de-commissioning, reuse, regularisation, and development caps on floor area and intensity. The workflow is low-cost, open-data based and transferable to other hazards and city sizes, providing actionable evidence for planners and governments seeking to align post-disaster responses with land-take control objectives.
abstract_zh: 土地政策日益在冲击与不确定性条件下运作，然而紧急措施如何导致持续性土地占用（land take）的机制仍未得到充分探讨。本文中，土地占用指涉及将自然、半自然或农业用地转化为人工用途的土地开发，通常与不透水地表覆盖相关。本文考察了意大利拉奎拉地震后道路通行限制、安全警戒线以及基础设施与便利设施选址如何与道路网络中心性和土地利用变化相互作用。采用构形方法，即空间句法（Space Syntax），对重建的地震前与地震后道路网络进行分析，我们计算了多半径下的分段整合度（NAIN）和选择度（NACH），并通过最近路段关联和缓冲区敏感性检验，将中心性十分位数与2014年震后商业及公共便利设施普查数据进行关联。结果显示，历史中心及其周边的道路封闭、高中心性道路走廊（尤其是红十字大道和SS17公路）的出现，以及灾后便利设施沿这些走廊及其邻近区域的集中，之间存在显著的空间对应关系。两个外围区域中心——托里奥内和托雷塔——也巩固为地方自治的服务节点，强化了一种仅与法定规划目标部分吻合的多中心格局。本文并未提出正式预测模型，而是利用单案例证据展示道路网络诊断如何有助于识别临时性土地利用和紧急相关土地占用最可能持续存在的走廊；支持战略道路连接重新开放的决策；并为退役、再利用、规范化以及建筑面积和强度开发上限提供有时限的规则依据。该工作流程成本低廉、基于开放数据，并可推广至其他灾害类型和城市规模，为规划者和政府提供可操作证据，以将灾后响应与土地占用控制目标相协调。
title: Emergency land take, road-network centrality and post-disaster land-use policy: Evidence from the post-earthquake reconstruction of L’Aquila, Italy
title_zh: 紧急土地征收、路网中心性与灾后土地利用政策：来自意大利拉奎拉震后重建的证据

abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 通常被引用的实证证据表明，通胀预期已更好地锚定，包括预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性随时间下降，特别是在采纳通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与一种基于经验的学习模型相符，在该模型中，个体仅从自身一生经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于公布的通胀目标。在此模型中，新冠疫情前几十年间长期存在的低短期通胀持续性经验，使得长期预期对通胀意外事件不敏感，与实证锚定测试中观察到的模式相匹配。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到验证：自1980年代以来，意外事件敏感性的下降在年轻个体中最为显著。对低通胀持续性经验的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。
title: Seemingly anchored inflation expectations
title_zh: 看似锚定的通胀预期

abstract: We study the causal impacts of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1-2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no impact on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on non-durable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.
abstract_zh: 我们研究收入对一系列就业结果的因果影响，利用了一项实验，其中1000名低收入个体被随机分配为每月无条件获得1000美元，为期三年，对照组2000名参与者每月获得50美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及手机应用数据。转移支付导致除转移外个人总收入相对于对照组每年下降约1900美元，劳动力市场参与率下降4.2个百分点。参与者因转移支付而减少工作时间每周1-2小时，且参与者的伴侣也减少了相当数量的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，转移支付带来的最大增加是休闲时间。尽管我们询问了关于工作条件的详细问题，但未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使是微小的改善。受助参与者总体上增加了支出，主要由非耐用品和服务支出带动，耐用品和人力资本支出增加较小。我们未观察到对学位获得的显著影响，尽管估计效应的大小在年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，受助参与者的主观幸福感指标较高，但随后恢复到对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动力供给效应，且这一效应并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。
title: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
title_zh: 保障性收入对就业的影响：来自美国两州的实验证据

abstract: We analyse the contribution of rising longevity to the increase in wealth inequality in the U.S. over the past seventy years. To do so, we construct an overlapping generations (OLG) model with multiple sources of inequality, carefully calibrated to the data. Our key finding is that improvements in old-age longevity have a substantial impact on wealth inequality, accounting for approximately half the effect of income inequality, which has been the focus of much of the existing literature. In contrast, the impact of tax changes is relatively minor. The contribution of rising longevity is expected to continue driving wealth inequality upward in the coming decades.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了过去七十年间美国寿命延长对财富不平等加剧的贡献。为此，我们构建了一个包含多种不平等来源的代际重叠（OLG）模型，并仔细校准至数据。我们的核心发现是，老年寿命的改善对财富不平等有显著影响，其效应约为收入不平等影响的一半，而后者一直是现有文献关注的焦点。相比之下，税收变化的影响相对较小。预期寿命延长将在未来几十年内继续推动财富不平等上升。
title: Demographic transition and the rise of wealth inequality
title_zh: 人口转型与财富不平等加剧

abstract: Political polarization can undermine democratic governance by weakening electoral accountability through biases in voter information consumption and processing. A growing literature, primarily from high-income countries, has identified promising interventions to reduce negative affect toward out-partisans, though evidence regarding their downstream effects remains mixed. We evaluate whether these depolarizing interventions and an open-mindedness nudge that increases awareness of information-processing biases stemming from emotions or partisanship promote counter-attitudinal information consumption and internalization in a survey of nearly 2,500 participants from a nationally representative panel in Mexico, a heavily polarized context. Videos designed to correct misperceptions about out-partisans improved trust in opposition media, while those designed to foster empathy or emphasize shared identities reduced partisan polarization. Although none of the videos affected immediate counter-attitudinal news consumption, exposure to either the corrective video or the open-mindedness nudge led to greater partisan attitudinal updating when participants were exposed to a counter-attitudinal news article. This effect is due to reduced partisan perceptions of the article rather than increased factual retention of its information. These findings provide insights into the potential and limitations of scalable interventions to improve citizens’ ability to consume and process politically relevant information across partisan lines.
abstract_zh: 政治极化可能通过选民信息消费与处理过程中的偏见削弱选举问责制，从而损害民主治理。现有文献主要基于高收入国家，已识别出若干有前景的干预措施以减少对外群体成员的负面情绪，但关于其下游效应的证据仍不一致。我们在墨西哥——一个高度极化的情境中，基于全国代表性面板的近2500名参与者开展调查，评估这些去极化干预措施以及一种增强对情绪或党派性所致信息处理偏见认知的开放性思维助推是否促进反态度信息消费与内化。旨在纠正对外群体误解的视频提升了对对立媒体的信任，而旨在培养同理心或强调共同身份的视频则降低了党派极化。尽管所有视频均未影响即时的反态度新闻消费，但当参与者接触到反态度新闻文章时，接触纠正性视频或开放性思维助推均导致更大的党派态度更新。这一效应归因于参与者对文章党派性感知的降低，而非对文章信息事实性记忆的增强。这些发现为可扩展干预措施在提升公民跨党派消费和处理政治相关信息能力方面的潜力与局限性提供了洞见。
title: Political Polarization and Counter-attitudinal Information Consumption and Internalization
title_zh: 政治极化与反态度信息消费及内化

abstract: This paper studies the impact of offshoring by US firms on voting patterns in the US. Using county-level voting data combined with industry-level offshoring data from 2000 to 2020, we ask whether an increase in employment at foreign affiliates of US multinational firms in vertically oriented industries is associated with an increase in the vote share for the incumbent party candidate in Presidential, House, and Senate elections. We find that offshoring leads to a significant increase in the incumbent vote share for counties with higher shares of college educated workers, and a significant decrease for counties with higher shares of workers in the manufacturing sector and in occupations that are more easily relocated abroad. These results are consistent with the labor market literature on offshoring and our own findings, which show that offshoring has heterogenous effects on workers’ employment based on skill and occupational tasks. This suggests that voters respond to the economic effects of offshoring by rewarding or punishing incumbent party candidates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国企业离岸外包对美国投票模式的影响。利用2000年至2020年县级投票数据结合行业级离岸外包数据，我们探讨了美国跨国公司在垂直导向行业中的海外附属机构就业增长，是否与总统、众议院及参议院选举中现任政党候选人得票份额的增加相关联。研究发现，离岸外包显著提升了拥有较高比例受过大学教育工人的县的现任候选人得票份额，而对于制造业工人比例较高及职业更易转移至海外的县，则显著降低了现任候选人的得票份额。这些结果与关于离岸外包的劳动力市场文献及我们自身的发现相吻合，表明离岸外包对工人就业的影响因技能和职业任务而异。这暗示选民会通过奖励或惩罚现任政党候选人，来回应离岸外包带来的经济效应。
title: Offshoring and Voting Patterns in the US
title_zh: 离岸外包与美国投票模式

abstract: In Turkey, mining companies are required to pay various types of forest fees to the forestry administration, as well as environmental compliance fees, state rights, and operating license fees to the relevant mining and environmental authorities. Rehabilitation and waste management costs, in contrast, are not fees calculated and collected directly by public authorities; rather, they are expenditures incurred by mining companies to fulfill their regulatory obligations. In recent years, legislative changes in Turkey concerning the calculation methods for land use fees and mining royalties required for mining operations have adversely affected the mining sector and reduced the attractiveness of mining investments. Therefore, assessing the economic feasibility of mining requires an integrated approach that considers the total financial burden imposed on mining companies rather than evaluating individual fees separately. To address this issue, data on various land use fees, operating costs, and other relevant parameters were collected from mining companies through the SurveyMonkey program. This analysis was motivated by the limited publicly available information on the actual magnitude of land use costs incurred by mining companies and the possibility that mining and environmental authorities may assess individual fees separately without considering their cumulative financial burden. Accordingly, this study evaluates land use fees and mining royalties in Turkey both individually and collectively, calculating their values per tonne of mineral production, per hectare of land, and on an annual basis. The ratios of these costs to mining operating costs were subsequently determined. The results indicate that the average land use cost is €1.65 ton⁻¹ year⁻¹ of mineral production and €3440.7 ha⁻¹ year⁻¹ of land used, while the combined land use fees included in the analysis account for 29.15% of total operating costs. Forest fees constitute the largest individual component, accounting for 8.39% of operating costs. In particular, revising the calculation methodology for forest fees and reducing the resulting financial burden could improve the economic feasibility and competitiveness of mining operations in Turkey.
abstract_zh: 在土耳其，矿业公司需向林业管理部门缴纳多种类型的林地使用费，同时还需向相关矿业及环保主管部门支付环境合规费、国家权益金及经营许可证费用。相比之下，恢复治理和废弃物管理成本并非由公共机构直接计算并征收的费用，而是矿业公司为履行监管义务而产生的支出。近年来，土耳其有关矿业用地使用费及采矿权益金计算方法的立法变动，对采矿业造成了不利影响，降低了矿业投资的吸引力。因此，评估采矿经济可行性需要采用综合方法，考虑矿业公司承担的总体财务负担，而非单独评估各项费用。为解决这一问题，通过SurveyMonkey程序向矿业公司收集了各类用地使用费、运营成本及其他相关参数的数据。此项分析的动因在于，关于矿业公司实际承担的用地成本规模，公开信息有限，且矿业与环保主管部门可能单独评估各项费用，而未考虑其累积财务负担。据此，本研究分别从单项和整体角度评估土耳其的用地使用费及采矿权益金，计算其每吨矿产产量、每公顷用地及年度基础上的数值，并进一步确定这些成本占矿业运营成本的比例。结果表明，平均用地成本为每吨矿产产量每年1.65欧元，每公顷用地每年3440.7欧元，而纳入分析的各项用地使用费合计占运营总成本的29.15%。林地使用费是最大的单项组成部分，占运营成本的8.39%。特别是，修订林地使用费的计算方法并降低由此产生的财务负担，有望提升土耳其矿业运营的经济可行性和竞争力。
title: The impact of high land use costs and mining royalties on mining operating costs in Turkey
title_zh: 高土地使用成本与采矿权使用费对土耳其矿业运营成本的影响

abstract: In conflict-affected contexts, the presence of armed actors—including state security forces, international peacekeeping missions, and non-state armed groups—means that aid organisations may need to cooperate with these actors to deliver foreign aid. Yet the conditions under which this cooperation happens remain underspecified. In this article, we use novel mixed methods data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to study these conditions. Building on qualitative interviews with Kinshasa-based aid practitioners, as well as a survey and survey experiment with Congolese provincial-level aid workers, we provide systematic evidence of the conditions under which humanitarian and development aid workers are more or less likely to collaborate with different types of armed actors across different regions of the country. We test three hypotheses: the type of armed actor, the visibility of cooperation, and the proximity to conflict. Our findings suggest that the type of armed actor and the proximity of the aid workers to conflict matter most. The public visibility of their collaboration is less important than anticipated. For those at the forefront of aid delivery, it is primarily the concrete realities and day-to-day interactions that appear to shape decision-making and behavior.
abstract_zh: 在冲突影响的环境中，武装行为体的存在——包括国家安保力量、国际维和任务及非国家武装团体——意味着援助组织可能需要与这些行为体合作以提供外国援助。然而，这种合作发生的条件仍未得到充分明确。本文利用来自刚果民主共和国（DRC）的新型混合方法数据来研究这些条件。基于对金沙萨援助从业者的定性访谈，以及对刚果省级援助工作者的调查和调查实验，我们提供了系统性证据，说明人道主义和发展援助工作者在不同地区与不同类型武装行为体合作的可能性条件。我们检验了三个假设：武装行为体的类型、合作的可见性以及与冲突的接近程度。我们的发现表明，武装行为体的类型和援助工作者与冲突的接近程度最为关键。他们合作的公开可见性不如预期重要。对于处于援助交付前线的人员而言，主要是具体的现实情况和日常互动塑造了决策和行为。
title: Aid and armed actors: Collaboration and aid delivery in the DRC
title_zh: 援助与武装行为体：刚果民主共和国中的合作与援助交付

abstract: Research and policy debates on population aging typically assume that immigration matters only through immigrants’ own fertility and its impact on total population size, ignoring effects on natives’ fertility. We study this margin in the context of the large inflow of Syrian refugees into Türkiye after 2011. Using an instrumental-variables strategy, we provide evidence that greater local exposure to refugees increases native fertility. Drawing on complete birth histories from the Demographic and Health Surveys, we find that the response operates primarily through earlier entry into motherhood and is concentrated among younger women. The result holds across three independent datasets, including administrative birth registers, and is mirrored in women’s stated ideal number of children. Examining potential mechanisms, we find the evidence most consistent with improved household economic security and find no support for channels operating through housing costs or the use of paid childcare.
abstract_zh: 关于人口老龄化的研究与政策辩论通常假定移民仅通过其自身的生育率及其对总人口规模的影响发挥作用，而忽视了移民对本地人生育率的影响。我们在2011年后大量叙利亚难民涌入土耳其的背景下研究了这一边际效应。利用工具变量策略，我们提供了证据表明，难民在当地更大的暴露程度会增加本地人的生育率。基于人口与健康调查中的完整生育史数据，我们发现这一反应主要通过提前进入母亲身份实现，并集中于较年轻的女性群体。该结果在三个独立数据集中均成立，包括行政出生登记记录，并且与女性自述的理想子女数量相呼应。在考察潜在机制时，我们发现证据最支持家庭经济安全改善的解释，而未发现通过住房成本或使用有偿托儿服务发挥作用的渠道支持。
title: Refugee immigration and natives’ fertility
title_zh: 难民移民与本地居民的生育率

abstract: We study the real effects of environmental activist investing. Using plant-chemical-level data, we find that targeted firms reduce their production-related emissions. Air quality improvements in the vicinity of targeted plants suggest potentially significant externalities for local economies. Reductions come from increased abatement expenditures and on-site source reduction initiatives, which negatively affect the financial performance of targeted firms. We rule out alternative explanations, including declines in production and plant closures, and provide evidence that firms respond to the specific demands of activists. Our findings suggest that environmental activism is an effective tool for long-term shareholders to address climate change risks. (JEL G23, G34, M14, Q50)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了环境激进投资者投资的真实效应。利用工厂-化学品层面的数据，我们发现被针对的企业减少了其生产相关的排放。目标工厂周边空气质量的改善表明，这可能对当地经济产生显著的外部性。减排源于增加的治理支出和现场源头削减举措，这些举措对被针对企业的财务表现产生了负面影响。我们排除了包括产量下降和工厂关闭在内的替代解释，并提供证据表明企业是对激进投资者的具体诉求作出回应。我们的研究结果表明，环境激进主义是长期股东应对气候变化风险的有效工具。（JEL G23, G34, M14, Q50）
title: The Real Effects of Environmental Activist Investing
title_zh: 环境积极主义投资的真实效应

abstract: We revisit the heterogeneous tax pass-through analysis in Borrella-Mas (2022a) (B&B). We find that B&B’s estimating equation is misspecified, as it excludes a necessary lower-order interaction between vertical integration and the post-treatment period. Including this term reveals a significant structural price trend for vertically integrated firms in the post-reform period, whose origin is uncertain. A spatial placebo test confirms that this structural shift is present even in never-treated provinces, indicating that it is not a local, province-level pass-through of the regional tax. Without this control, the original specification may conflate this shift with the tax effect. Once the interaction is included, the differential pass-through estimate becomes null for diesel, while for gasoline a significant effect persists—albeit at a reduced magnitude—supporting B&B’s central claim that market structure matters for tax pass-through. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly modelling group-specific time trends when estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in difference-in-differences designs.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了Borrella-Mas (2022a)（简称B&B）中的异质性税收转嫁分析。我们发现B&B的估计方程设定有误，因为它遗漏了垂直整合与处理后时期之间必要的低阶交互项。纳入这一项后，揭示了改革后时期垂直整合企业显著的结构性价格趋势，其来源尚不确定。空间安慰剂检验证实，即使在从未受处理的省份也存在这种结构性转变，表明这并非地方性的省级税收转嫁效应。若无此控制，原始设定可能将这一转变与税收效应混淆。一旦加入交互项，柴油的差异化转嫁估计变为零，而汽油则仍存在显著效应——尽管幅度有所减小——这支持了B&B的核心主张，即市场结构对税收转嫁具有重要影响。这些发现强调了在双重差分设计中估计异质性处理效应时，明确建模组别特定时间趋势的重要性。
title: A Comment on “The Heterogeneous Tax Pass-Through Under Different Vertical Relationships” by Bajo-Buenestado and Borrella-Mas
title_zh: 对巴霍-布埃内斯塔多与博雷利亚-马斯《不同纵向关系下的异质性税收转嫁》一文的评论

abstract: Alabama is a high-poverty state with permissive small-dollar credit regulation and one of the largest licenced alternative financial service provider (AFSP) markets in the United States. Using Alabama State Banking Department licencing data for 2011, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2020, we estimate Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) models with high-dimensional fixed effects to examine conditional spatial associations between traditional financial institutions (TFIs), socioeconomic and demographic characteristics, and counts of deferred-presentment providers (payday lenders), small-loan providers, and pawnshops. Models are estimated at census-tract, ZIP-code, and county levels, and two-part hurdle models separate AFSP presence from conditional intensity. The results are more consistent with co-location than with a spatial-void account. Lagged credit-union intensity shows the most consistent positive association with AFSP counts across specifications, especially at the ZIP-code level, while lagged bank intensity is positive in most specifications, with significance concentrated on the ZIP-code intensity and tract-level entry margins. Population size and an inverted-U income gradient are the strongest predictors. Demographic associations are strongest at the tract level, especially Hispanic share, share aged 65 and over, and lower educational attainment, while Black share is not significant in the main PPML models. The findings underscore the importance of spatial scale for interpreting AFSP location. KEYWORDS: Alternative financial service providers traditional financial institutions payday spatial scale credit-market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G23 Acknowledgements We sincerely appreciate the valuable feedback from peers in American Council on Consumer Interests (ACCI)’s Early-Career Professional Development Mentorship Program.
abstract_zh: 阿拉巴马州是一个高贫困州，其小额信贷监管较为宽松，并拥有美国规模最大的持牌替代性金融服务提供商（AFSP）市场之一。利用阿拉巴马州银行部2011年、2014年、2015年、2016年和2020年的许可数据，我们估计了具有高维固定效应的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型，以考察传统金融机构（TFIs）、社会经济与人口特征，以及延期付款提供商（发薪日贷款机构）、小额贷款机构和当铺数量之间的条件空间关联。模型在人口普查区、邮政编码区和县三个层面进行估计，两部分的障碍模型将AFSP的存在与条件强度区分开来。结果更支持共选址而非空间空白假说。滞后信用合作社强度与AFSP数量在各规格中呈现最一致的正向关联，尤其在邮政编码区层面；而滞后银行强度在大多数规格中为正，显著性集中于邮政编码区强度及人口普查区进入边际。人口规模和倒U型收入梯度是最强的预测因子。人口特征关联在人口普查区层面最强，尤其是西班牙裔占比、65岁及以上人口占比以及较低的教育程度，而黑人占比在主要PPML模型中不显著。研究结果强调了空间尺度对解释AFSP选址的重要性。关键词：替代性金融服务提供商；传统金融机构；发薪日贷款；空间尺度；信贷市场分割 JEL分类：G21 G23 致谢：我们衷心感谢美国消费者利益委员会（ACCI）早期职业专业发展导师计划中同行们的宝贵反馈。
title: The spatial distribution of alternative financial service providers in Alabama: a multi-scale analysis
title_zh: 阿拉巴马州替代性金融服务提供者的空间分布：多尺度分析

abstract: Using A-share listed firms from the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges between 2007 and 2021 as the research sample, this article examines the impact of merchant guild culture on the speed at which firms adjust towards their target level of tax avoidance. The baseline results show that merchant guild culture significantly accelerates the adjustment speed. Mechanism analyses show that merchant guild culture enhances adjustment speed by improving internal coordination efficiency and reducing agency costs. Further research reveals that the enhancing effect of merchant guild culture on the adjustment speed is more pronounced when the actual level of tax avoidance is below the target. The promoting effect of merchant guild culture on tax adjustment speed is more evident in firms where the chairman’s place of origin or birthplace matches the registered location of the listed firm, those facing stronger product market competition, and those located in regions with weaker tax enforcement. This article not only identifies a new factor influencing tax avoidance adjustments, addressing a gap in the existing literature, but also examines the economic consequences of merchant guild culture from the perspective of tax management, providing insights into how merchant guild culture shapes corporate behaviour. KEYWORDS: Merchant guild culture target level of tax avoidance adjustment speed corporate governance JEL CLASSIFICATION: H26 M14
abstract_zh: 以2007—2021年沪深A股上市公司为研究样本，本文考察了商帮文化对企业向目标避税水平调整速度的影响。基准结果表明，商帮文化显著加快了企业避税调整速度。机制分析显示，商帮文化通过提升内部协调效率和降低代理成本来加快调整速度。进一步研究发现，当实际避税水平低于目标水平时，商帮文化对调整速度的促进作用更为显著。商帮文化对避税调整速度的促进效应在董事长籍贯或出生地与上市公司注册地一致的企业、面临更强产品市场竞争的企业以及位于税收征管较弱地区的企业中更为明显。本文不仅识别了影响避税调整的新因素，弥补了现有文献的空白，还从税收管理视角考察了商帮文化的经济后果，为理解商帮文化如何塑造企业行为提供了启示。关键词：商帮文化；目标避税水平；调整速度；公司治理 JEL分类：H26；M14
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Merchant guild culture and dynamic adjustment of corporate tax avoidance: evidence from China
title_zh: 商帮文化与企业避税的动态调整——来自中国的证据

abstract: We estimate the peer effects of paternity leave‐taking among male co‐workers using the 2006 Quebec paternity leave reform. Using high‐quality administrative data, we closely follow the birth date regression discontinuity research design of Dahl et al. (2014) who studied a similar reform in Norway in 1993 which resembles the Quebec reform. Depending on the length of follow‐up, we estimate that having a male co‐worker take paternity leave increases the probability that a father of a newborn takes leave by 3 to 6 percentage points. While the statistical significance of our findings differ from Dahl et al. (2014) using Norwegian data, these estimates are nevertheless consistent with the 11 percentage point increase they report.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2006年魁北克省陪产假改革，估算了男性同事间陪产假休假的同伴效应。借助高质量行政数据，我们紧密遵循Dahl等人（2014）的出生日期断点回归研究设计，该研究分析了1993年挪威一项与魁北克改革相似的改革。根据随访时间长短的不同，我们估计，有一位男性同事休陪产假会使新生儿父亲休陪产假的概率增加3至6个百分点。尽管我们研究结果的统计显著性与Dahl等人（2014）使用挪威数据得出的结论有所不同，但这些估计值仍与他们报告的11个百分点增幅相一致。
title: Peer effects at work on parental leave: Why is Papa not more involved?
title_zh: 工作中的同伴效应与育儿假：为何爸爸参与度不高？

abstract: The present article employs probate records to analyse private wealth accumulation and distribution in Montevideo between 1760 and 1825. The results reveal four major findings. Firstly, there was a sustained rise in average wealth over time, even in the face of independence‐related wars. Secondly, asset portfolios became more complex and urban‐oriented. Thirdly, wealth inequality declined over the period under study. Finally, Montevideo exhibited relatively low levels of inequality in comparison with other contemporary global regions. The distribution of urban real estate and enslaved individuals, in particular, became more equitable, revealing a distinctive pattern of slave ownership. Notwithstanding these more general improvements, the top decile continued to accumulate significant fortunes. The findings are consistent with the importance of frontier conditions, institutional frameworks, and warfare for understanding distributive outcomes in this setting. The case of Montevideo highlights the historical contingency of inequality trajectories over time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用遗嘱认证记录，分析了1760年至1825年间蒙得维的亚的私人财富积累与分配情况。研究结果揭示了四大主要发现。首先，即便在独立战争期间，平均财富也呈现出持续增长的趋势。其次，资产组合变得更加复杂且偏向城市导向。第三，在所研究期间，财富不平等程度有所下降。最后，与同期全球其他地区相比，蒙得维的亚的不平等水平相对较低。特别是城市房地产和被奴役人口的分配变得更加公平，显示出一种独特的奴隶所有权模式。尽管存在这些总体改善，但最富有的十分之一人口仍持续积累巨额财富。这些发现与边疆条件、制度框架和战争对理解该地区分配结果的重要性相吻合。蒙得维的亚的案例凸显了不平等轨迹随时间变化的历史偶然性。
title: Wealth and inequality in Spanish America, from colonial rule to the eve of independence in Montevideo
title_zh: 从殖民统治到独立前夕：西班牙美洲的财富与不平等——以蒙得维的亚为例

abstract: We provide direct evidence on how the public expects the government to satisfy its intertemporal budget constraint. In a representative survey of U.S. households, respondents expect only 45% of government debt to be financed by future primary surpluses and 23% to be rolled over indefinitely without ever generating surpluses, as if sustained by a bubble. Experts perceive an even larger bubble (37%). Beliefs respond to fundamentals: at a debt-to-GDP ratio of 150%, the perceived bubble shrinks to 15%. A New Keynesian model calibrated to these beliefs implies a 13% larger government spending multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于公众如何预期政府满足其跨期预算约束的直接证据。在一项具有代表性的美国家庭调查中，受访者预期仅有45%的政府债务将由未来基本盈余融资，而23%的债务将被无限期滚动而不产生任何盈余，仿佛由泡沫支撑。专家感知到的泡沫更大（37%）。信念对基本面因素有所反应：当债务与GDP之比达到150%时，感知到的泡沫缩小至15%。一个根据这些信念校准的新凯恩斯模型显示，政府支出乘数将增加13%。
title: Perceived Budget Constraint of the Government
title_zh: 政府感知预算约束

abstract: This paper constructs a new annual panel for 14 Western countries over 1800–2016, linking homicide to alcohol consumption (by beverage type), drug offenses, deterrence, and education. The central innovation is the first harmonized long-run cross-country alcohol series that can be aligned with the major historical waves in lethal violence. Across graphical evidence, narratives, and multivariate panel regressions, homicide co-moves strongly with alcohol, while education, deterrence, and demography capture the broader institutional context. We interpret the estimates as suggestive long-run relationships and use them for a multivariate historical accounting of the post-war crime wave and subsequent decline.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个覆盖14个西方国家、时间跨度为1800年至2016年的新型年度面板数据，将凶杀案与酒精消费（按饮料类型）、毒品犯罪、威慑力量及教育水平联系起来。核心创新在于首次建立了与致命暴力主要历史浪潮相吻合的、协调一致的长期跨国酒精消费序列。通过图形证据、叙事分析和多元面板回归，凶杀案与酒精消费呈现强相关性，而教育、威慑及人口结构则捕捉了更广泛的制度背景。我们将这些估计解读为提示性的长期关系，并利用它们对战后犯罪浪潮及其后续下降进行多元历史核算。
title: From spirits to crime: two centuries of alcohol and homicide in the West
title_zh: 从烈酒到犯罪：西方两个世纪的酒精与凶杀

abstract: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济模型，能够解释若干关键资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率及其周期性。名义刚性放大了负向生产率冲击后股息的前瞻性周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为价格调整迟缓导致股息逐步恢复。因此，短久期股票（债券）的支付比长久期对应物更具（更不）前瞻性周期性。缓慢变动的消费习惯产生大规模、反周期的风险价格，从而得出符合现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展至同时包含市场消费习惯和家庭消费习惯，使其能在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实宏观经济动态。
title: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
title_zh: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型

abstract: The current opioid epidemic is the worst drug epidemic the U.S. has ever faced. We examine the role of social connections in its spatial spread. Having many friendship links to counties with high opioid exposure positively correlates with overdose death rates. To address identification concerns, we exploit two quasi-natural experiments that led users to substitute illicit opioids for prescription drugs. Having more friends exposed to counties affected by these shocks leads to more overdose deaths. We also provide suggestive evidence that spillovers affect different stages of addiction, are influenced by both supply- and demand-side conditions, and are attenuated in counties with more cohesive local friendship networks. Our results show how social connections contribute to the spread of the opioid epidemic.
abstract_zh: 当前阿片类药物危机是美国历史上最严重的药物流行病。我们考察了社会联系在其空间传播中的作用。与阿片类药物暴露水平较高的县拥有众多友谊链接，与过量死亡率的上升呈正相关。为解决识别问题，我们利用了两个准自然实验，这些实验导致使用者从处方药转向非法阿片类药物。更多朋友暴露于受这些冲击影响的县，会导致更多过量死亡。我们还提供了初步证据表明，溢出效应影响成瘾的不同阶段，受供需双方条件的影响，并在地方友谊网络更为紧密的县中有所减弱。我们的研究结果表明，社会联系如何促进阿片类药物流行病的传播。
title: Friends with drugs: The role of social networks in the opioid epidemic
title_zh: 毒品之友：社交网络在阿片类药物流行中的作用

abstract: The European Union's AI Act – the world’s most ambitious regulatory framework for artificial intelligence to date – was supposed to enter into full effect on 2 August 2026. But while the AI Act's transparency layer has come into effect, obliging providers to inform individuals when they interact with an AI system, its high-risk regime – covering biometric identification, recruitment systems, credit scoring, law enforcement, and border control – has been delayed. This column argues that the result is a double bind in which Europe loses regulatory sovereignty whether it enforces its own rules or retreats from them.
abstract_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》——迄今为止全球最具雄心的AI监管框架——原定于2026年8月2日全面生效。然而，尽管该法案的透明度条款已生效，要求提供商在个人与AI系统互动时告知对方，但其高风险制度——涵盖生物识别、招聘系统、信用评分、执法及边境管控——已被推迟。本专栏认为，其结果是一种双重困境：无论欧洲是执行自身规则还是退让回避，都将丧失监管主权。
title: Europe's regulatory double bind
title_zh: 欧洲的监管双重困境

abstract: We study how couples in the Medicare Part D program choose an insurance plan. Over 70 percent of enrollees choose the same plan as their spouse. Even among those with differing healthcare needs, well over half do so. Discrete-choice models suggest beneficiaries value being on the same plan as their spouse at hundreds of dollars per year. A regression-discontinuity design shows that quasi-random variation in an older spouse's choice of plan affects their younger spouse's choice. We present a decomposition exercise to assess how much the tendency for couples to choose the same plan contributes to overspending in the program.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了医疗保险D部分计划中夫妻如何选择保险计划。超过70%的参保者选择与配偶相同的计划。即便在医疗需求不同的夫妻中，也有超过半数这样做。离散选择模型显示，受益人每年愿意为与配偶选择同一计划支付数百美元。断点回归设计表明，年长配偶计划选择的准随机变化会影响年轻配偶的选择。我们进行了分解分析，以评估夫妻倾向于选择相同计划对计划中过度支出的贡献程度。
title: Social Defaults and Plan Choice: The Case of Spousal Following
title_zh: 社会默认与计划选择：配偶跟随的案例

abstract: We revisit a randomized experiment that demonstrated the cost-effectiveness of group-based, compared to individual, consulting services for firms in the Colombian auto parts industry using administrative data that now permits following firms for up to a decade. Firms in the group consulting intervention are more likely to survive, have higher employment, and have increased sales and profits by approximately 50%. This longer-term growth appears to in part come through increased exporting, as well as persistent management improvements. Case studies offer insights into underlying mechanisms. The more expensive individual consulting has noisy long-term impacts that are much less cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了一项随机实验，该实验通过行政数据展示了哥伦比亚汽车零部件行业中，相较于个体咨询，团体咨询对企业服务的成本效益，如今这些数据允许对企业进行长达十年的追踪。参与团体咨询干预的企业更有可能存活，就业人数更高，销售额和利润约增长50%。这种长期增长部分似乎源于出口增加，以及持续的管理改进。案例研究揭示了背后的机制。成本更高的个体咨询在长期影响上存在噪音，且成本效益远低于团体咨询。
title: Group Consulting Continues to Benefit Firms after a Decade: Experimental Evidence from Colombian Auto Parts Firms
title_zh: 十年后集团咨询仍使企业受益：来自哥伦比亚汽车零部件企业的实验证据

abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of contraceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们采用随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X——一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目——寻求护理的女性，并随机分配代金券，使全面避孕措施大幅折扣或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持久的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响则尚无定论。
title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Controlled Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国扩大避孕药具经济可及性能否减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES随机对照试验两年期的证据

abstract: Health plans in the U.S. increasingly use cost-sharing to steer demand for prescription drugs. However, the effectiveness of these incentives depends both on physicians’ price sensitivity and their knowledge of patient costs. We employ a moment inequality model to identify physician preferences without fully specifying their information. Applying this model to diabetes care, we find that physicians generally lack detailed price information and are more price sensitive than full-information models imply. We also identify substantial heterogeneity in preferences and information by physician training, suggesting a benefit from targeted information interventions.
abstract_zh: 美国健康计划日益采用费用分摊机制来引导处方药需求。然而，这些激励措施的有效性既取决于医生的价格敏感度，也取决于他们对患者成本的了解程度。我们运用矩不等式模型来识别医生偏好，无需完全设定其信息结构。将该模型应用于糖尿病护理领域，我们发现医生普遍缺乏详细的价格信息，且其价格敏感度高于完全信息模型所暗示的水平。我们还识别出医生培训背景导致的偏好和信息方面的显著异质性，这表明有针对性的信息干预措施可能带来益处。
title: Patient Costs and Physicians’ Information
title_zh: 患者成本与医生信息
